core/locale/fallback.ts

Build-time English translation snapshot. The Vite plugin
Source src/core/locale/fallback.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

(module scope)

Shape of the translations/ DB node inlined by the Vite plugin.

FALLBACK

English UI copy snapshotted from database.json at build time. Components read live translations from the store first and fall back to this snapshot, so no user-visible string lives in JavaScript source.

FALLBACK_APP

The APP subtree of the fallback snapshot — app-shell copy (actions, carousel labels, loader lines) consumed before Firebase resolves.

FALLBACK_COMPONENTS

The components subtree — per-component copy fallbacks keyed by component token (e.g. aboutSection, siteToast).

FALLBACK_PAGES

The pages subtree — per-page fallback nodes (home, about, legal…).
